steps.body: A join story has two known parts and one whole. The bar shows 7 and 5 joining to make 12.
steps.narration: A join story has two known parts and one whole. The bar shows 7 and 5 joining to make 12.

widget.prompt: A story gives two parts. Hop forward from the first part by the second part's size.
widget.missFeedback: Start at 24 and count on 15: you land on 39.
widget.successFeedback: Landed on 39 — the two parts combine to the whole, just like the story describes.

predict.prompt: A story names two separate groups and asks how many in all. What operation fits?
predict.reveal: Finding the total of two known groups always means combining them: addition. The total must land above both groups — subtracting would leave you below one of them, and no total is smaller than its parts.
